description.value: Westwood Motel is a renovated motel situated off Highway 97 in 100 Mile House, a common overnight stop on the BC Interior touring corridor. Rooms include a refrigerator, microwave, and coffee maker, and BBQ facilities are available on site. The motel sits within a short walk of several restaurants and is close to the 100 Mile House Airstrip.
